name: Transcripts MCP Server
description: A remote Model Context Protocol server that retrieves and cleans Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts via the Microsoft Graph API using delegated OAuth 2.0 authentication. It enables AI agents to discover meetings, extract speaker-attributed text, and save transcripts to SharePoint for analysis and automation.
